items.label: Plush Fleece for Soft Warmth
items.value: Made from a premium 50% Cotton and 50% Polyester blend with a soft, plush fleece interior. This thick and cozy fabric feels comfortable against the skin, effectively trapping body heat for ideal warmth and breathability in fall and winter

items.label: Classic Silhouette & Practical Design
items.value: Features a signature oversized fit with dropped shoulders for a relaxed, Y2K-inspired aesthetic. The hood adds a casual touch and extra coverage, while two side pockets offer practical convenience, making it a stylish and functional everyday

items.label: Effortless Layered Styling
items.value: The perfect canvas for layered outfits. Wear it over tees, tank tops, or button-downs, or layer it under a coat or jacket. Pair it with jeans, joggers, leggings, or skirts to easily achieve styles ranging from casual streetwear to cozy loungewear

items.label: Versatile for Casual Occasions
items.value: Designed for everyday moments where comfort is key. It’s ideal for lounging at home, campus life, weekend errands, casual gatherings, or outdoor walks. Its comfortable stretch also suits commuting, travel, and light activities, making it a versatile piece from fall through winter

items.label: Quality Crafted with Detail in Mind
items.value: Crafted with attention to details that impact wear. From durable stitching and fabric to the comfortably elastic ribbed trims, it’s made for lasting comfort. EFAN is committed to accessible style and comfort, aiming for this fleece hoodie to be a reliable and stylish staple in your wardrobe
